title: Mini-sprint roadmap brief and risk decomposition for QBR
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Produce a compact 'mini-sprint' deck (10 slides + appendix) for the upcoming QBR that surfaces portfolio-level investment signals, immediate decision asks, and a decomposed risk map. The goal is a tightly argued readout that lets execs choose between (A) allocate 20% additional Dedicated capacity for Q2 runtime throughput, (B) prioritize latency-first kernel work with a 12-week runway, or (C) defer build and pilot SmartRouting for burst optimization. Deliverables: slide deck, 1-page decision heatmap, and an action tracker with owners.
decision_asks: Approve incremental Dedicated capacity commit: +20% GPUs for a 3-month pilot (cost estimate and SLA terms included)
Authorize funding for latency kernel sprint (cross-team allocation of 4 engineers x 8 weeks)
Approve go/no-go on SmartRouting pilot with staging traffic for 2 weeks and rollback criteria
risk_decomposition: Runtime throughput risk: likelihood medium, impact high — caused by queue tail latencies during burst windows
Cost risk: likelihood medium, impact medium — further capacity will increase committed spend without guaranteed utilization
Quality regression risk from quantization changes: likelihood low, impact high — requires canary evals and gold prompt suite
Operational complexity: likelihood high, impact medium — SmartRouting introduces routing policy surface and observability gaps to address
metrics: Dedicated pool utilization: 72% week-average, spikes to 96% during peak hours
Readout KPIs: delta in 95th latency if kernel sprint funded, projected -25%
